title: gamekit_test
description: GameKit showcase 11x7: two chambers joined by a single door '7' at (5,3). Left chamber: key spawner '8' at (3,1), battery spawners '6' at (2,4) and (3,2), parcel spawners '1' at (1,1), (3,3), (1,5). Right chamber: key spawner '8' at (6,5), deliveries '2' at (6,1) and (7,1), double-delivery '9' at (7,2) and (8,5), battery spawner '6' at (9,3), parcel spawners '1' at (8,2) and (7,4). Pick the key, cross the door, deliver on '2' for normal score and on '9' for doubled score; recharge on batteries spawned over '6' tiles. Rows are listed top-to-bottom while internal y grows upward.
